title: Music of Melanesia - Wikipedia
text: November 25, 2025 - Melanesian music refers to the various musical traditions found across the vast region of Melanesia. Vocal music is very common across Melanesia; sitting dances are also attested. Hand gestures are an important part of many songs, and most traditional music is dance music.
